content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking to implement a ramp function for an oven or heating element. The goal is to start at 20°C, increase by 3°C per minute up to 90°C, hold 90°C for 60 minutes, then further increase by 3°C per minute up to 180°C and maintain 180°C for 120 minutes. Afterward, step down to 80°C by 3°C per minute. Is it possible to do this with a [product_name] controller featuring an [product_name] analog module and PT100 sensor? The heating element is managed using a triac with 4-32VDC control. Best regards, [user_name]
